run.description: Intentionally weak role-only baseline: trusts the claimed identity; checks only that the role includes the operation. Own in-memory state; never touches WAKALA. Not representative of all real IAM systems.

definitions.decision_only: Gateway-measured time for authentication + policy + approval gate (excludes audit write and monitoring).
definitions.gateway_wall: Full Gateway.authorize call: decision + hash-chained audit write + monitoring observer.
definitions.gateway_execute_wall: Gateway.execute: authorization + protected service dispatch + transactional outcome audit.
definitions.end_to_end_case: Machine time from intake to COMPLETED with simulated agents; no human time, no network.

stress.probe: direct-mandate residency.check_eligibility via Gateway.authorize (decision + audit + monitoring), file SQLite

delegation_depth.note: Depths 2-3 are not permitted by the current synthetic grant (max_delegation_depth=1), so they cannot be measured as authorized chains; the attempt above is measured as a denial.

stress.dimensions_held_constant: Each series varies one dimension in a fresh isolated environment; same probe request.

independent_incidents.condition: Each incident in its own fresh isolated environment (no cross-incident history).

business_model_defaults.label: HYPOTHETICAL MODEL — every input is an assumption, not an observed government statistic.

assumption_notes.annual_agent_operations: ASSUMPTION — protected AI-agent operations per year for one entity.
assumption_notes.manual_review_pct: ASSUMPTION — share of operations a manual-review-heavy process routes to an officer.
assumption_notes.manual_review_minutes: ASSUMPTION — average officer time per routine manual review.
assumption_notes.staff_cost_per_fte_year: ASSUMPTION — fully loaded annual cost of one reviewer (salary, benefits, overhead).
assumption_notes.productive_hours_per_fte_year: ASSUMPTION — productive review hours per FTE per year.
assumption_notes.wakala_exception_review_pct: ASSUMPTION — share of operations escalated to officers with WAKALA (incidents + holds).
assumption_notes.exception_review_minutes: ASSUMPTION — average officer time per WAKALA exception review.
assumption_notes.legally_required_review_pct: ASSUMPTION — share of operations that must be human-reviewed by law/policy in BOTH scenarios.
assumption_notes.annual_platform_and_integration_cost: ASSUMPTION — annual WAKALA platform, integration and operations cost.

break_even.note: Operations per year (or manual-review share) at which review savings equal the platform cost.

observed_in_synthetic_benchmark.source: configuration C of this synthetic run (attack-heavy mix; NOT a forecast of real traffic)

limits: WAKALA does not decide visa eligibility and does not change approval rates.
Human review required by law or policy is kept in both scenarios (legally_required_review_pct).
Exception rates observed in the synthetic benchmark depend on its attack mix and are not a forecast.

run.label: Synthetic prototype benchmark — not production government statistics.
run.isolation: Every configuration runs in its own temporary environment (fresh dev keys in a temp dir, in-memory or temp-file SQLite, random in-memory officer passwords). The server database and backend/.dev_keys are never used.
